meta.name: D2 Relay
meta.shortDescription: Relay D1 UTXOs to the D2 testnet
meta.longDescription: This pup monitors UTXOs sent or received in each Dogecoin (D1) block and relays them to the D2 testnet, enabling stress test scenarios. It reports testnet metrics to the Dogebox GUI.

metrics.name: d1_height
metrics.label: D1 Height
metrics.description: Latest Dogecoin (D1) block height processed by the relay

metrics.name: d2_height
metrics.label: D2 Height
metrics.description: Current D2 chain tip height reported by d2_getInfo.

metrics.name: last_block
metrics.label: Last D1 Block
metrics.description: Hash of the last processed D1 block

metrics.name: utxos_created
metrics.label: UTXOs Created
metrics.description: Total UTXOs created (transaction outputs seen in processed D1 blocks)

metrics.name: utxos_spent
metrics.label: UTXOs Spent
metrics.description: Total UTXOs spent (transaction inputs seen in processed D1 blocks)

metrics.name: relayed_txs
metrics.label: Relayed Transactions
metrics.description: Total D1 transactions successfully relayed to the D2 testnet

metrics.name: relay_lag
metrics.label: Relay Lag (blocks)
metrics.description: D1 height minus D2 tip height (0 when D2 has caught up)

metrics.name: blocks_processed
metrics.label: Blocks Processed
metrics.description: Number of D1 blocks the relay has scanned since it started.

metrics.name: failed_txs
metrics.label: Failed TXs
metrics.description: Transactions that failed to relay into the D2 node since the relay started.

metrics.name: doge_relayed
metrics.label: DOGE Relayed
metrics.description: Total DOGE value (sum of outputs) of transactions successfully relayed into D2 since the relay started.
